notes: Manufacturer datasheet (clearcom.com) used as authoritative source, cross-checked against Markertek's spec table. ARCADIA-X4-32P is the 32-Licensed-Port variant with 4-pin XLR-M headset jack (the X5 variant uses a 5-pin XLR-F instead). Port-count/type mappings that needed a "closest match" against the allowed connector-id list: (1) the front-panel Headset jack is a 4-pin XLR-M for audio+mic, not DC power - mapped to xlr4-dc only because that is the sole 4-pin XLR id available; (2) the two rear GPIO connectors are DB9F (D-sub 9-pin, not RS-232 serial) - mapped to rs232 as the closest D-sub id available, each carries 1 optically-isolated GPI + 2 relay GPO per connector (2 GPI / 4 GPO total across both); (3) the DC power inlet uses a locking KPJX-4S-S connector (12V DC, 12A max) which is closer to a 4-pin locking DC connector than a barrel jack - mapped to dc-barrel as closest available id. The "Program Audio In / Stage Announce Out" (XLR-3F in / XLR-3M out) is NOT a separate chassis jack - it is accessed by breaking out RJ45 4-Wire port #8 using the included CAB-RJ45-PGM-SA cable, so it was not added as a distinct physical port. LAN RJ45/SFP and FreeSpeak E1 RJ45/SFP ports carry no manufacturer-stated Ethernet speed grade for the device's own interface (only "recommended switch" guidance of 100/1000 Base-T was given, which describes external switches, not confirmed Arcadia port speed), so grade was omitted per instructions. USB-A port version/speed is not stated in the datasheet, so grade omitted. Unit ships with an external 12V/12.5A PSU (PSU-EXT-001, IEC-C14 input) as an alternative to using the internal AC supply directly - the AC IEC-C14 inlet listed is the unit's own primary power input.
